name: skill-grader
description: AI Skill Grader, inside Codex. At the start of each session it gives a plain-English read on any skill it hasn't shown you yet: what it can touch and what to check first. It uses the same static check as the site, with no LLM and no network. It also blocks a manipulative skill's scripts from running. Ask for the full report on any skill.

interface.shortDescription: A plain-English read on what a skill can touch before you rely on it.
